title: James and the Giant Peach by Ronald Dahl
description:
Novels and Nibbles grasp the final days of peach season with this story about James, an orphan who lives with his two cruel aunts. After a mysterious old man gives James a paper bag filled with magical crystals and tells him to follow his instructions and something wonderful will happen, clumsy James trips and spills the crystals by the old peach tree. A giant peach grows with giant friendly insects inside that become his friends and they face many perils together, successfully crossing the ocean to NYC. A whimsical story of courage, friendship and discovering family doesn’t have to be related by blood.

Grilled Peach Toast with Pimento Cheese and the combo is just heavenly on your tongue. La Farm’s Melange Boule is thick cut and grilled so it has that perfect crunchy softness. Now for the toppings: house-made pimento cheese, grilled peaches, thinly shaved radishes, arugula, fresh cracked black pepper and a whisper of Himalayan pink salt.

Like James, this open-face sandwich turns an unexpected combination of flavors into a mouthwatering journey.
